definitions.explanation: An adult female human. Also used as a prefix to indicate female gender of various things.

examples.notes: 女の人 is more polite than 女 alone

examples.japanese: {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：noentry⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{女|おんな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれています→分かれる：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The toilets are divided into male and female.
This song is popular with women, but it's also often listened to by men.

examples.english: She works at a company while raising two girls, and although she seems busy every day, she's always smiling.

notes:
{女|おんな} means woman or female.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {女|おんな}: plain (can sound blunt)
- {女|おんな}の{人|ひと}: polite (recommended)
- {女性|じょせい}: formal/written

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl
- {女|おんな}の{人|ひと}: woman (polite)
- {女子|じょし}: girl, female (as prefix)
- {女性|じょせい}: woman, female (formal)
- {女優|じょゆう}: actress

KANJI READINGS:
- おんな: kun'yomi (standalone)
- じょ/にょ: on'yomi (in compounds)

CONTRAST:
- {女|おんな}: woman ↔ {男|おとこ}: man
- {女性|じょせい}: female ↔ {男性|だんせい}: male

NOTE: Using {女|おんな} alone to refer to a specific person can sound rude; prefer {女|おんな}の{人|ひと}.
